# Build your own Custom Integration

The RateMyAgent API gives you the flexibility to build custom widgets, review carousels, and bring your listings directly onto your own website.

To do this, you'll need your own design and development team — or a trusted partner to build it for you.

**Preferred partners (AU & NZ only):**
​[Stafflink](https://intercom.help/ratemyagent/en/articles/6954362-stafflink) and [Website Blue](https://intercom.help/ratemyagent/en/articles/6954365-website-blue)

## Subscription requirements

To access the custom integration, you'll need an active subscription on one of the following plans:

- **Agency Attract**
- **Agent Amplify & Attract**
- **Office Enterprise**
- **Agent Pro**

If you're not currently on one of these plans, reach out to our team to discuss upgrading before proceeding.

## Design requirements

There's just one non-negotiable: the **"Powered by RateMyAgent" logo** must appear on every page where RateMyAgent data is displayed.

Beyond that, you're free to design your implementation however suits your brand.

## Need inspiration?

Our [design guide](https://www.figma.com/proto/RLjbn7TVdp9NoqoBotMNRX/API-Reviews-Guide?node-id=11%3A0&viewport=449%2C387%2C0.5&scaling=min-zoom) offers suggested styles and layouts — though you're not restricted to these.
​*(Click through the prototype using your left/right arrow keys to browse pages.)*

It covers:

1. Brand & usage guidelines
2. Recommended implementations
3. Templates

We recommend sharing the PDF at the bottom of this article with your internal team or supplier, it outlines the technical requirements, available endpoints, and accessible data for the build.

## Ready to get started?

To proceed with a custom integration, you'll need to sign our API contract via DocuSign. Get in touch by:

- Emailing [apirequest@ratemyagent.com](mailto:apirequest@ratemyagent.com), or
- Using the **live chat** feature in the bottom-right corner of this page
